title: Huge unidentified underwater craft prompt US–UK–Soviet defense contacts
place_text: Pacific Ocean, Baltic Sea, North Sea, Atlantic Ocean

tellings.quote: very large unidentified underwater craft were discovered and cited in the Pacific Ocean.

plain: The president of a Russian republic, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, read from an account saying that very large unidentified craft were found moving underwater in the Pacific Ocean, and the story also places such sightings in the Baltic Sea, the North Sea and the Atlantic. According to the telling, these sightings led the defense officials of the United States, Britain and the Soviet Union to contact each other. If true, it would mean the rival powers took the craft seriously enough to talk to one another about them.
